title: How the sync layer works
description: A walkthrough before the code review. Nothing to pick: read it, then confirm, or leave a question in the box.

sections.title: 1. Every write lands locally first
sections.body: The app never waits on the network. A write goes to the local store and to an **outbox** in one transaction, and the sync worker drains the outbox whenever a connection exists.

sections.title: 2. Conflicts resolve per field
sections.body:
| Case | Rule |
|---|---|
| The same field edited on two devices | Last write wins, by server timestamp |
| Deleted on one device, edited on another | The edit wins and the note comes back |
| Offline for more than 30 days | Full re-download, then the outbox replays on top |

sections.title: 3. Offline is the normal case
sections.body: Sync is opt-in per user. With it off, the app is a purely local notes app and the outbox is never drained.
